title: Chapter 1169 - 29: Xuanhuang (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1169 - 29: Xuanhuang (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1169: Chapter 29: Xuanhuang (Seeking Subscription)

Outside Xuanhuang Universe.

The minds of many Chaos Venerables were shaken, and it took them a while to regain their composure.

"Just now, did a Supreme Great Saint enter?"

"A single thought forms the void, replacing the rules of the Chaos Void. It must be a Supreme Great Saint. Only a Supreme Great Saint can form a new void rule and path in an instant."

"Ah, a Supreme Great Saint..."

The Chaos Venerables quickly conversed and discussed. The Chaos evolution power foundation of a Supreme Great Saint is hefty enough to bear numerous rules and paths of the Chaos Void, which makes forming new rules possible.

Becoming a Supreme Great Saint, strength is secondary.

It further signifies that the path one’s taking is broad enough.

Although there are myriad paths, all leading to the same destination, the paths have no differences in rank.

But a muddy trail compared to a heavenly path.

Even if both can reach the end, the processes are vastly different.

Simply said, for a Chaos Great Saint to become a Supreme Great Saint, it is unrelated to talent and aptitude.

It depends on whether the path of strength one walks is hefty and wide.

Why did the Eye of Myriad Laws immediately perceive that Lin Yuan could become a Supreme Great Saint upon detecting the evolution path Lin Yuan let it spread, originating from the branch of his own evolution path?

It’s because the Martial Arts Evolution Road can branch out so many paths at the Path Splitting Realm stage, even reaching paths with potential at the Chaos Realm...

One can imagine how broad and weighty the Martial Arts Evolution Road itself is.

Such an evolution path, as long as it grows smoothly, becoming a Supreme Great Saint is inevitable.

...

"Were two Supreme Great Saints here just now?"

"Two Supreme Great Saints?"

The Chaos Venerables quickly communicated. Some Venerable caught a fleeting glimpse of two vague figures arriving instantaneously from distant spacetime.

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint never intended to enter the Xuanhuang Universe quietly.

As Supreme Great Saints, they should roam freely in the Chaos Void. How could they sneak around?

Therefore, they never concealed themselves, but even so, most Chaos Venerables couldn’t even lift their heads under the pressure of Supreme Great Saints; only a few saw their vague forms.

"Did both Supreme Great Saints enter this Postnatal Universe?"

"It seems this Postnatal Universe truly has a significant background."

"Whether it has a significant background, I’m not concerned as it has nothing to do with me."

"Indeed, just that Galaxy Saint... is rather unfortunate..."

The Chaos Venerables suddenly thought of the situation within the Xuanhuang Universe.

Since suppressing Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, and the other eight Chaos Great Saints, this Postnatal Universe was completely occupied by Galaxy Great Saint.

With the combat power Galaxy Great Saint displayed, other Chaos Great Saints dared not enter. As for the Chaos Venerables originally inside? Galaxy Great Saint didn’t expel them, but these Chaos Venerables knew their limits, only daring to wander around the outer regions of the Xuanhuang Universe.

Simply put, this Postnatal Universe has already become Galaxy Great Saint’s backyard.

But now, the arrival of two Supreme Great Saints has completely disrupted this scenario.

Galaxy Great Saint is strong, his domain world could make numerous rules and paths retreat, but after the decision of several Chaos Great Saints, Galaxy Great Saint ultimately did not reach the level of Supreme Great Saint.

In this situation, with two Supreme Great Saints entering, the conclusion for Galaxy Great Saint within the universe is almost predictable.

If lucky, and those two Supreme Great Saints are in a good mood, he might leave alive, but the gains from this trip within the universe would surely have to be surrendered.

If unlucky? Just like Galaxy Great Saint treated Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, suppressed by two Supreme Great Saints, exchanging with ’ransom.’

If even unluckier, if detested by the two Supreme Great Saints, there’s a chance of directly facing death.

The stature of Supreme Great Saints is too high, they don’t care much about ’ransom.’

....

Distant Void Domain.

Wild Barbarian Great Saint saw many friends, none willing to step in to assist him in negotiating with Galaxy Great Saint.

At that moment.

Wild Barbarian Great Saint received news.

"Two Supreme Great Saints entered that Postnatal Universe too?"

Upon hearing this, Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s expression was not of joy but fear.

His main battle body was in the hands of Galaxy Great Saint in the Xuanhuang Universe, so he was very concerned about information from that area, immediately being aware of the two Supreme Great Saints’ arrival.

"Things have become complicated."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s brows knitted tightly. The exchange for his main battle body in the hands of Lin Yuan required a high price, but at least that price was determined.

For instance, Wild Barbarian Great Saint only needed to gather ten billion Chaos Stones to regain his main battle body.

This is what Galaxy Great Saint agreed to.

Such a mighty existence generally would not be untrustworthy.

But now with two additional Supreme Great Saints? It’s beyond Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s control.

With two Supreme Great Saints entering the Postnatal Universe, Galaxy Great Saint should be suppressed, meaning the main battle bodies of these Chaos Great Saints fall into the hands of the two Supreme Great Saints.

Galaxy Great Saint was willing to exchange their main battle bodies for ten billion Chaos Stones, doesn’t mean the two Supreme Great Saints would do the same.

"Galaxy Great Saint, you must escape..."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint gazed towards the Xuanhuang Universe, silently pondering.

He inexplicably hoped that Galaxy Great Saint, who suppressed his main battle body, could escape from the hands of those two Supreme Great Saints.

...

Not only Wild Barbarian Great Saint, but Black Light Great Saint, Tian Lu Great Saint also felt uneasy, the entrance of Supreme Great Saints made the situation increasingly complex.
